title: AmiGHOs
tagline: a seamless way to track, share, and settle expenses among (crypto-native) friends
description: Split bills, not friendships – settle smart with amiGHOs. The aim of the project is to enable people to manage group expenses with ease on-chains using GHO stablecoin. Being on-chain allows features like pre-pooling and interest accrual for debts which would otherwise be hard to implement.
how_its_made: The project uses NextJS 13 with Shadcn and Tailwind CSS for UI, GHO Testnet smart contracts and custom Solidity contracts for the business logic of managing groups, relevant expenses, pre-pooling and interest accruals. It also makes use of Connect Kit along with wagmi for intreracting with users' wallets.
